result.title: CTXAgent - Self-Controlled Context Management of LLM Agents
result.summary: Agent harnesses keep long sessions inside the context window by compacting the history when a token threshold is crossed. We study an alternative in which the model manages its own context: it decides when to compact, what to keep and what to write as the hand-off, given two tools and one paragraph of guidance. Since earlier work found that open-weight models cannot manage their own context without scaffolding, we compare seven frontier models under identical conditions, with and without the context tools, on token cost and benchmark score, and we compare our harness with three widely used harnesses on two of these models. The benchmark is assembled from existing ones: coding exercises, multi-step SciCode problems and SWE-bench Pro and Terminal-Bench 4.0 tasks are interleaved with planted facts, ephemeral observations and standing instructions, all checked deterministically, in sessions of 35-212 turns that resemble a user working through different tasks in one chat. Most of the strongest models manage their context: they compact and curate regularly, the live context of the mixed sessions stays mostly below 100k tokens, and their benchmark scores mostly do not drop significantly. For the models that manage their context well, the cost reduction is substantial but varies between models, because some models compact so often that other costs increase. With Claude Opus 5.5, the self-managed harness matches Claude Code on task success at 34% lower cost than its explicit 200k-window configuration and 49% lower than its default, with no context window to choose. We release the agent, the benchmark and all result rows.

AI.brief_summary: 研究让模型自主管理上下文的 LLM agent：给定两个工具和一段简短指引，模型自行决定何时压缩历史、保留什么内容、如何写交接说明；在由编程题、SciCode、SWE-bench Pro 等拼装的长会话基准上，比较七个前沿模型与三种常用 harness 的 token 成本与得分。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「自主决定何时压缩、保留哪些信息」的机制，可供核查 latent 推理状态中任务必要信息如何保留、如何避免坍缩以及何时触发状态更新或停止的线索；属纯文本 agent 工作，与视觉推理的联系需人工判断。
